text:
You sit down as the train reaches
full speed. Soon the rhythmic
motion of the train lulls you to
sleep.
You wake up after a couple of
stops. You feel refreshed. Heal 2
Life.
You get off the train and continue
your exploration of the town, but
you now have traveled 1 or 2
boxes from your previous location
(you choose where).

zh-CN.title: 16 - 驶向未知的列车
text:
你坐下时，火车已达到全速。车厢有节奏的摇晃很快让你昏昏入睡。
几站之后你醒来，感觉精神振作。恢复2点生命。
你下车继续探索小镇，但现在你的位置已经离先前地点相隔1或2格（由你选择具体位置）。
